title: Solar AI ground PV condition 4-class research v1
subtitle: Active 4-class PV condition set - unverified provenance (grade C)
description:
Solar AI ground-level PV CONDITION research dataset — ACTIVE 4-CLASS taxonomy (experimental).

PERSONAL, NON-COMMERCIAL RESEARCH ONLY. Provenance grade C, tagged `personal-experimental-unverified-provenance`. Derived from the project's existing 5-class condition dataset by REMOVING every ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE annotation (never relabelled as PHYSICAL_DAMAGE or any other class) — the source audit found those boxes visually correspond to cell cracks, not confirmed electrical failure. The underlying photographs ultimately trace to Kaggle `pythonafroz/solar-panel-images`, whose Kaggle licence is UNKNOWN. Do NOT redistribute, publish, use commercially, or claim verified CC BY image rights for the underlying images.

Classes (contiguous, ACTIVE taxonomy): 0=CLEAN 1=DUSTY 2=BIRD_DROP 3=PHYSICAL_DAMAGE. ELECTRICAL_DAMAGE, SNOW, and the ambiguous 'Defective' are excluded. PANEL is not a class here — this feeds a SECOND-STAGE condition model that runs on panel crops from the separate ground panel detector.

PHYSICAL_DAMAGE is the rarest active class (314 images / 725 instances vs. DUSTY's 1,364 images / 8,550 instances) — a known class-imbalance limitation.

2411 images: train 1686 / valid 483 / test 242. Leakage-safe split preserved EXACTLY from the 5-class dataset's own leakage-clean family-grouped split (a class-filtered subset of a leakage-clean split stays leakage-clean by construction). Detection format, bounding boxes preserved verbatim for the surviving classes (no fabricated boxes). provenance/ carries the full build report and per-image manifest.

Not a validated engineering or safety diagnosis.
